domain: Gamified Paper Trading and Investment Learning

theme_strategy.rationale: High-energy, gamified 'Bloomberg Terminal meets mobile game' aesthetic targeting Gen Z college students. Dark mode emphasizes the glowing neon accents and glassmorphism cards, creating a premium and engaging learning environment.

surfaces_and_glassmorphism.card_base: bg-[rgba(255,255,255,0.05)] backdrop-blur-[12px] border border-white/10 rounded-2xl shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.37)] transition-all duration-300
surfaces_and_glassmorphism.header_nav: bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10 sticky top-0 z-50
surfaces_and_glassmorphism.bottom_tab_bar_mobile: bg-[#111111]/90 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-white/10 fixed bottom-0 w-full z-50 md:hidden

layout_and_spacing.desktop: Sidebar navigation (w-64) with main content area. Dashboard uses Bento Grid with tight gaps (gap-6).
layout_and_spacing.mobile: Bottom tab bar navigation. Full width cards with generous padding (p-4 to p-6).
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: p-4, p-6, p-8 for internal card padding to avoid content colliding with glass borders.

buttons.primary: bg-[#6C63FF] text-white hover:bg-[#5A52D5] hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(108,99,255,0.4)] rounded-lg font-semibold transition-all
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#00D4FF] text-[#00D4FF] hover:bg-[#00D4FF]/10 rounded-lg font-semibold transition-all

components_strategy.inputs: bg-black/40 border border-white/10 focus:border-[#6C63FF] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#6C63FF] rounded-lg text-white backdrop-blur-md
components_strategy.badges: px-2 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold backdrop-blur-md border
components_strategy.charts: Recharts with transparent backgrounds, #6C63FF for lines, #00FF88 and #FF4444 for candlesticks.

animations_and_motion.micro_interactions: Smooth scaling on hover (scale 1.02), pulsing effects for live data, celebratory particle effects for XP/Level ups.

testing_requirements.rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.

hero_background.description: Dynamic long exposure neon light streaks on dark background for marketing hero section.

ai_chatbot_orb.description: Abstract CGI iridescent sphere floating, representing the AI Assistant Orb.

trading_terminal_bg.description: Crypto trading screen with graphs and charts for the terminal background or empty states.

user_avatar_placeholder.description: Modern Indian college student portrait for user profile placeholder.

iconography.style: Stroke width 1.5 to 2, clean and geometric.

pages_and_routes.name: Marketing Landing
pages_and_routes.description: Hero section, value props, floating AI orb.

pages_and_routes.name: Dashboard
pages_and_routes.description: XP bar, stats bento grid, portfolio summary.

pages_and_routes.name: Roadmap
pages_and_routes.description: Gamified learning journey with Town nodes.

pages_and_routes.name: Town Detail
pages_and_routes.description: Lessons and quizzes for a specific town.

pages_and_routes.name: Paper Trading Terminal
pages_and_routes.description: Desktop-only candlestick charts and order panel.

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize the dark mode gamified aesthetic. Use the defined glassmorphism card classes exclusively for containers.
Implement the layout with a sidebar on desktop (min-width 768px) and a bottom tab bar on mobile.
Integrate Framer Motion for all route transitions and micro-interactions on hover/click.
Ensure all interactive elements have valid `data-testid` attributes.
The paper trading terminal must be responsive but hide complex chart features gracefully on mobile, with a prompt to 'Use Desktop for Full Terminal'.
Do not build authentication flows; assume the user is logged in as 'Guest' or mock user.
